_comment: Curated descriptions for the solve.js CLI subcommands. Consumed by scripts/gen-solve-commands-index.js (run via `npm run steering:llm:pack`) to emit docs/steering/llm/solve-commands.md. Keys MUST match the COMMANDS map in scripts/solve.js: a registered command missing here renders as `(undocumented)` and a key here that is not registered renders under `Documented but not registered`, so `npm run steering:check` fails on either drift. Add or correct entries here, not in the generated markdown.

new.summary: Create a versioned Quest draft under solve/quests/<id>.json. Drafting is not sealing: the first execution command lints and declares it. Link flags author the planning graph without hand-editing JSON; --force is refused once append-only history exists.

run.summary: Run the Quest loop toward SOLVED/EXHAUSTED. Bare `run --id <id>` uses the default `dry` executor (a no-op skeleton — it prints a banner saying so); real autonomous work needs `--executor agent --yes`. Add `--keep-alive` to replay only progress-bearing MAX_CYCLES boundaries; judgment and repair stops return once with a typed action.

status.summary: Show the current Quest state: active frontier, rung, and recent movement.

report.summary: Project the event log into the terminal report / closure projection.

portfolio.summary: Cross-Quest portfolio view and meta-ratio over all quests.

frontier.summary: Render the frontier board; `--write` persists it to solve/FRONTIER.generated.md (the durable boot board).

overview.summary: Live roadmap -> epic -> spec -> quest -> ledger overview; `--write` persists it.

trace.summary: Cross-layer planning trace joining quests via their `links` block. Pass exactly one selector.

handoff.summary: Compute the scope-safe git pathspec for committing exactly one terminal Quest; dry-run by default, `--commit` executes only after the full audit and aggregate source approval pass.

checkpoint.summary: Explicitly commit one scope-clean mid-Quest attempt after its exact patch fingerprint is approved and the current path-limited delta is unchanged. Never pushes; --dry-run renders a read-only hypothetical-approval dossier so unlandable candidates are fixed before verifier delegation.

invariants.summary: Tier-2 live-evidence verification of architecture invariants (the standing dual of doneWhen): derive HELD/BREACHED/UNGUARDED for entries in architecture/contracts/invariants.json that carry a liveEvidence block, as a fold over the Solver event log. Always active (unconditional).

probe.summary: Run a registered probe directly over real artifacts and print its JSON result; the Solver trusts probes, not self-report. Takes no --id and does no quest resolution — every argument other than --probe is passed through to the probe itself.

finding.summary: Record durable knowledge in the append-only Quest log. Exact verifier approvals and rejections bind subagent evidence to a content fingerprint; recording either verdict never commits.

promote-finding.summary: Promote a recorded finding into in-repo steering as a rule (then regenerate with `npm run steering:llm:pack`).

override.summary: Recorded-reason escape hatch: authorize one bypass of an overridable guard (only the heuristic theory/scope guards; never honesty/integrity invariants). Requires a falsifiable --reason.

reflect.summary: Record a reflection think-cycle (no attempt, no metric claim): micro by default, or `--altitude` to question the frame. `--note` is required.

step.summary: Begin a supervised attempt: pins the frontier and prints the rung dossier. Records nothing until `--commit` (or `--abort` to discard the pending attempt). At commit time, `--auto-diff` snapshots `git diff` against the pin recorded at step begin into solve/changes/<id>/attempt-<n>.diff and uses it as the changeRef (errors if nothing changed; solver-generated bookkeeping — solve/FRONTIER.generated.md, solve/state, solve/log, solve/report — is excluded from the snapshot; an explicit --changeRef takes precedence and prints a warning that --auto-diff was ignored).

step-pending.summary: Print the pending supervised step (the pinned baseline attempt awaiting a commit) as JSON.

next.summary: Typed "what do I do next?" projection: folds pending-step state, the last recorded stop, the current-blocker card, advisories, and the exact checkpoint-readiness dossier. It delegates only structurally checkpoint-landable source candidates and distinguishes executable-command, command-template, manual-action, and terminal actions. Use --json for the stable machine-readable projection.

doctor.summary: Read-only operator preflight. Reports Git/worktree state, absent/malformed/disabled/enabled local agent configuration, live adapter executability, the no-op example adapter, attribution validity, and the recommended autonomous or supervised mode. Use --json for the stable machine-readable report.

lint.summary: Read-only Quest authoring validation. --id checks one Quest; --all reports the versioned/legacy census without rewriting historical Quest files or logs.

theory.summary: Two-layer (system + frontier) theory management used to break a stall: system, option, select, record, supersede, list, card, import-ledger.

health.summary: Quest health diagnostics: stall, oscillation, and coupled-invariant signals that gate the theory/reflection rungs.

ingest-evidence.summary: Stamp an external evidence artifact onto a frontier (or doneWhen) so a probe can read it.

attempt.summary: Record a one-shot measured attempt that runs a harness command and captures the result as evidence.

audit.summary: Run the Quest audit (scope and evidence-honesty checks) that gates a git handoff.

upgrade.summary: Idempotently append a `quest-upgraded` strict-audit baseline event to the Quest log, ingest any unrecorded evidence, and regenerate the report.

reopen.summary: Reopen a parked frontier whose exhaustion verdict was driven by non-measuring (invalid) samples; resets it to the first rung for honestly-measured attempts. `--reason` is required to justify the reopen; `--frontier` defaults when exactly one frontier is parked.

park.summary: Operator-decision terminal: park an open frontier as `exhausted` with provenance `operator` when an altitude reflection concluded PARK/EXHAUST-AND-PIVOT (frame refuted or sealed symptom absent on HEAD). Requires a prior `reflect --altitude` on the quest and a falsifiable --reason; appends the quest-level EXHAUSTED terminal when every frontier is parked exhausted.
park.usage: node scripts/solve.js park --id <id> [--frontier <f>] --reason "<why no honest remaining move exists>"
